description: One deterministic rival god with independent Divine Power, Saint/Priest, Oracles, cooldowns, and ordinary faith propagation. Begins with real existing households, no free population or land.
name: 暮影信仰

semantics.genesis: Existing households indexed from zero change affiliation to r2 at the same genesis; no new people, houses, land or stocks.
semantics.agency: Rival clergy and Saints emerge under the same requirements. The opponent uses existing Miracle/Oracle evaluation, costs, cooldown and physical outcomes. It cannot directly order individual workers.
semantics.decisions: At most one Miracle per AI decision interval; prioritizes real nearby water/crop/healing needs, then a blessing. Occasionally attempts a hostile confusion spell where local faith dominance permits.
semantics.rivalry: Active sermons from both faiths affect uncommitted people symmetrically. Followers at Devotion 40+ are safe from routine opponent preaching; under 40 may erode and switch after 20.
semantics.replay: Separate opponentRng and saved counters support deterministic replay. Loading an old single-God save does not retroactively enable the opponent.
semantics.tuning: All values are experimental and not an authoritative main/docs rule.
